vocabulary.meaning_en: a written plan or idea that you ask others to accept
vocabulary.example: We need to write a proposal for the boss.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to prepare or create something from different parts
vocabulary.example: Let's put together a proposal.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to be easy to notice because it is better or different
vocabulary.example: Use positive words to make your proposal stand out.

vocabulary.meaning_en: much better than usual
vocabulary.example: This is an exceptional product.

vocabulary.meaning_en: extremely good
vocabulary.example: It has fantastic potential.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how good something is
vocabulary.example: Our customers expect high quality.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money a business earns after paying its costs
vocabulary.example: Our profits will increase.

vocabulary.meaning_en: working well without wasting time, money or effort
vocabulary.example: The new machine will improve efficiency.

vocabulary.meaning_en: working well without waste
vocabulary.example: Making production more efficient saves money.

vocabulary.meaning_en: worth the price you pay
vocabulary.example: Our products are good value for money.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the possibility of becoming successful in the future
vocabulary.example: This idea has great potential.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to help or be good for someone; an advantage
vocabulary.example: This plan will benefit the business.

vocabulary.meaning_en: short
vocabulary.example: Your proposal should be brief but clear.

vocabulary.meaning_en: words that sound good and hopeful
vocabulary.example: Use positive language in a proposal.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to aim a product at a particular group of customers
vocabulary.example: We could target restaurants and cafes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how much people want to buy something
vocabulary.example: Demand for this product is growing.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the process of making goods
vocabulary.example: Production costs are too high.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something that makes a place look nicer
vocabulary.example: Plastic fruit is often used as a decoration.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stop thinking about something, such as work
vocabulary.meaning_ar: يتوقف عن التفكير في العمل / يرتاح
vocabulary.example: Can you not switch off from work for one minute?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have found an idea that could be successful
vocabulary.example: You could be on to something here.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to present an idea to persuade someone
vocabulary.example: We can pitch this to Paul on Monday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very early, before doing anything else
vocabulary.example: I'll call you first thing tomorrow.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to think of an idea
vocabulary.example: We came up with a great idea.

fine_lines.title: efficient vs effective
fine_lines.explanation_ar: effective تعني أنه يحقق النتيجة المطلوبة. efficient تعني أنه يحققها دون هدر للوقت أو المال أو الجهد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Effective means it gets the result you want. Efficient means it gets the result without wasting time, money or effort.

examples.sentence: The new system is more efficient – it saves an hour a day.
The advert was effective – sales went up.

fine_lines.title: profit vs benefit
fine_lines.explanation_ar: profit هو المال الذي تربحه الشركة بعد طرح التكاليف. benefit أي فائدة أو ميزة، وقد لا تكون مالية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Profit is money a business makes after costs. Benefit is any advantage or good result, not only money.

examples.sentence: The company made a profit of $1 million.
One benefit of this job is flexible hours.

expressions.meaning_en: A strong positive word for a proposal.
A strong positive word for a proposal.
A key word showing the product is good.
expressions.example: We offer top quality at a low price.

expressions.meaning_en: A key word showing how the business will gain money.
expressions.example: This product will increase our profit.

expressions.meaning_en: A key word showing how the business will save time or money.
expressions.example: The new process will improve efficiency.

expressions.meaning_en: A key phrase showing customers get a good deal.
expressions.example: Our customers will get value for money.

expressions.phrase: Your proposal needs to be brief but clear.
expressions.meaning_ar: يجب أن يكون مقترحك موجزًا لكن واضحًا.
expressions.example: Remember, your proposal needs to be brief but clear.

expressions.phrase: You could be on to something here.
expressions.meaning_ar: قد تكون توصلت إلى فكرة واعدة هنا.
expressions.meaning_en: Saying an idea might be successful.
expressions.example: That's a clever idea – you could be on to something here.

grammar.title: Future predictions with will
grammar.explanation_ar: في المقترحات نستخدم will + الفعل للتنبؤ بالنتائج الإيجابية بثقة: our profits will increase، customers will get value for money.
grammar.explanation_en: In proposals use will + base verb to predict good results with confidence: our profits will increase.
examples: Our customers will get value for money.
This product will benefit the business.

grammar.title: By + verb-ing to show how
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم by + الفعل مع ing لشرح الطريقة التي نحقق بها شيئًا: By making production more efficient, we will save money.
grammar.explanation_en: Use by + -ing to explain the method or how something happens: By making production more efficient, we will save money.
examples: By making production more efficient, our profits will increase.
By targeting cafes, we can sell more.
You can save time by planning ahead.

grammar.title: Adjective + noun with positive words
grammar.explanation_ar: الصفة في الإنجليزية تأتي قبل الاسم، عكس العربية: an exceptional product (منتج استثنائي)، fantastic potential.
grammar.explanation_en: In English the adjective comes before the noun (the opposite of Arabic): an exceptional product, fantastic potential.
